finding.title: No favicon found
finding.detail: Google shows a site's favicon next to its name in mobile search results. Without one you get a generic globe icon, which reads as less established than the competitors around you.
finding.fix: Add a favicon at /favicon.ico plus a 180x180 apple-touch-icon, and declare them in the head.
finding.snippet:
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any">
<link rel="icon" href="/icon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
